svg.text: pos. relative to outer edge: x - 141.5, y - 72.5 (PCB coords)
1/4"-20 tripod: Ø6.5 + hex nut pocket 11.4 AF x 5.8 deep (from inside)
CONCEPT v0 - not yet validated. All dimensions in mm.
X/Y match KiCad PCB coordinates; outer box = PCB 111x49 + 0.5 gap + 2.0 wall,
plus a 10 mm solid plinth at the bottom for the tripod nut.
Parts: front shell (front + side walls + plinth) and a flat back lid.
Assembly: 4x M3 heat-set inserts in Ø6.0 front bosses (16.5 high),
M3x18 screws from the back through lid spacer tubes and PCB holes.
Radome: front wall 1.0 mm over the radar, solid infill, no metal/paint;
keep the antenna-to-wall gap small (<1 mm) or tune wall to ~3.8 mm (lambda/2 PLA).
Display: window = active area + 0.5. Glass position from seller photo:
MEASURE the module before printing; FPC (wider border) is on the left.
Buttons: 6 mm tact switch top ~5 mm above PCB -> printed caps with
~13.5 mm stem and retaining flange, or 13 mm tall tact switches.
Tripod: 1/4"-20 hex nut pressed into the pocket from inside before the PCB.
- XIAO (U3) moved to the top edge, USB-C facing up through the top wall.
- SW1 changed to angled OS102011MA1Q at the top edge, lever through slot.
- Battery wire to J3 needs a notch/slot: J3 is on the front side.
Stack (measure): display glass ~15, radar antenna ~16 above PCB top.
